svg.title: @benchmark
svg.desc: Isometric contribution terrain for @benchmark from 2024-12-29 to 2025-12-27. 803 contributions across 142 active days. 0 wonders discovered. relative normalization, maximum 12.

g.aria-label: Contribution height legend. Relative P90 scale from 0 to 12 contributions. Five palette bins from low to high.

rect.aria-label: Empty contribution height; representative elevation 0 of 99
Low contribution height; representative elevation 20 of 99
Mid contribution height; representative elevation 45 of 99
High contribution height; representative elevation 70 of 99
Max contribution height; representative elevation 99 of 99

g.aria-label: Calendar timeline from 2024-12-29 to 2025-12-27. Month and season cues follow supplied contribution dates.

svg.text: Water and trees are scenery, not contributions
